913cc46b82413df2.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Manager - Governance Risk & Compliance (Construction) to oversee governance, risk management, and compliance activities within construction programs and projects. This full-time role ensures adherence to organizational policies, regulatory requirements, contractual obligations, and industry best practices. The Manager will support the establishment and maintenance of effective frameworks, controls, and monitoring processes that promote project integrity and operational excellence. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this position is to drive proactive risk identification, compliance oversight, and governance reporting. This supports successful project delivery and organizational objectives by ensuring all construction activities align with established standards and mitigate potential risks effectively. Key Responsibilities Implement and maintain construction governance, risk management, and compliance frameworks across assigned projects and programs. Monitor compliance with organizational policies, governance requirements, regulatory obligations, and project controls standards. Facilitate risk identification, assessment, mitigation planning, and risk monitoring activities across construction portfolios. Conduct governance reviews, compliance assessments, audits, and assurance activities to evaluate adherence to established requirements. Track and report governance, compliance, and risk management performance indicators and key metrics. Support the development and implementation of risk registers, control frameworks, compliance plans, and governance procedures. Coordinate corrective actions, mitigation plans, and continuous improvement initiatives arising from audit findings or compliance reviews. Collaborate with Project Delivery, Commercial, Procurement, Legal, Finance, Internal Audit, and Risk functions to address governance and compliance matters. Review project governance documentation, approvals, delegations, and decision-making processes to ensure compliance with established requirements. Support regulatory engagement activities and facilitate responses to governance, compliance, and risk-related inquiries. Prepare governance reports, executive dashboards, risk summaries, and committee presentations. Promote risk awareness, compliance culture, and governance best practices across project teams and stakeholders. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration, Risk Management, Law, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications such as PMP, PMI-RMP, CRMP, CIA, CISA, or ISO 31000 are preferred. 6–10 years of progressive experience in governance, risk management, compliance, construction controls, audit, project management, or related disciplines. Demonstrated experience supporting governance and compliance activities within large-scale construction, infrastructure, real estate, or capital project environments. Proven ability to conduct risk assessments, compliance reviews, and assurance activities. Experience developing governance frameworks, policies, procedures, and control mechanisms. Capability to work effectively with multidisciplinary project teams, contractors, consultants, and regulatory stakeholders. Proficiency in preparing governance reporting, risk analysis, and executive-level presentations. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this full-time position.

91422fe7e8cd565e.description: About the Role alfanar is seeking a Network Security Specialist to join its team. This full-time role involves the daily administration, maintenance, and monitoring of the organization’s security infrastructure. The specialist will focus on ensuring that firewalls, NAC systems, and WAFs are correctly configured to protect company assets and support secure business operations. The position requires 3-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Configure and maintain enterprise firewalls (Palo Alto/Fortinet/Cisco), IDS/IPS, and VPN gateways. Administer Aruba ClearPass for Network Access Control (NAC), including managing guest access, BYOD policies, and *** troubleshooting. Monitor and tune WAF policies to protect web applications, ensuring regular signature updates and analyzing blocked traffic logs. Apply security baselines to network devices and ensure compliance. Execute network segmentation tasks as directed, restricting internal traffic according to the principle of least privilege. Perform regular firewall rule reviews to identify and decommission unused or risky policies. Conduct vulnerability scans using tools like Nessus or Qualys and assist in the technical remediation of identified risks. Act as Tier 2 support for security incidents, analyzing SIEM alerts and escalating complex threats to the Senior Engineer or SOC lead. Coordinate with vendors to resolve hardware or software defects. Maintain technical documentation for all security configurations, network diagrams, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Collect evidence for security audits to demonstrate compliance with NCA ECC and internal policies. Performance Criteria Timely resolution of security-related service requests and troubleshooting incidents. Successful implementation of firewall and WAF changes with zero unauthorized downtime. Ensuring seamless authentication for corporate and guest devices via Aruba ClearPass. Keeping all security asset inventories and diagrams up to date. General Accountabilities Assist in daily operational tasks and collaborate effectively within the team to meet functional objectives, supporting efforts to enhance workflow efficiency and team productivity. Provide operational support in executing strategy plans, ensuring tasks are completed in alignment with broader organizational objectives. Support the implementation and maintenance of operational policies and procedures, ensuring compliance with standards and contributing to the efficiency and effectiveness of daily operations. Experience Required Candidates should possess 3-5 years of experience in network security roles, with a focus on security infrastructure administration and maintenance.

916f5285495d47d8.description: About Fast Fit Fast Fit EMS Fitness Company was established in 2019 and has since become a prominent EMS fitness brand in Saudi Arabia. The company operates 11 fitness clubs across major cities, providing high-quality EMS training solutions. Fast Fit is dedicated to innovation, client satisfaction, and fostering career growth for its employees. Role Overview Fast Fit is seeking a Personal Fitness Trainer (EMS Specialist) for a full-time position in Al Khobar. This role involves delivering safe, effective, and personalized EMS-based training programs to clients. The trainer will focus on client assessment, program design, performance monitoring, and client motivation, while ensuring compliance with health and safety standards. This position is crucial for client retention, achieving transformation outcomes, and maintaining overall service quality. Key Responsibilities Deliver safe and effective EMS-based training programs. Conduct client assessments to understand individual needs and goals. Design personalized training programs tailored to each client. Monitor client performance and progress throughout their training. Motivate clients to achieve their fitness objectives. Ensure adherence to all health and safety standards during training sessions. Contribute to client retention and positive transformation outcomes. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in Exercise Science, Sports Science, Physical Education, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Personal Trainer Certification from a recognized organization (*, NASM, ACE, ISSA, REPs, or equivalent) is preferred. Candidates with 2-5 years of strong hands-on experience in personal training or EMS-based training will be considered. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a dynamic fitness environment focused on delivering high-quality EMS training solutions and ensuring client satisfaction.

This full-time role involves designing and implementing system architectures to ensure security frameworks for Azeus Convene, a multi-awarded meeting and collaboration solution. The successful candidate will receive intensive on-the-job training and mentoring. Role Overview As a Systems Engineer, you will coordinate with systems administrators and project team members to manage system configurations. This includes setting up and maintaining cost-effective and efficient hardware and software to meet project requirements. The role focuses on ensuring system security and operational efficiency for a product with a global footprint across over 100 countries. Key Responsibilities Set up servers with hardening and firewall policies between servers. Implement applications developed by Azeus in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, KSA cloud, etc.). Lead the implementation of Azeus applications at client premises, including server and application software hardening and firewall policy setup. Identify and analyze system integration problems. Resolve server issues by identifying root causes and implementing immediate remedial actions. Formulate and implement corrective actions for recurring problems. Formulate and implement preventive actions to avoid future occurrences of issues. Identify recurrent tasks and recommend tools for automation. Provide on-call support for critical cases. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience. The role requires individuals who are fast learners with excellent problem-solving capabilities. Required Skills Excellent problem-solving skills. Strong organizational skills with the ability to perform effectively under pressure and time constraints. Flexibility and adaptability to changing shift schedules, including potential work on weekends, holidays, and across different time zones. Excellent interpersonal and leadership skills. Work Type This is a full-time position within the Azeus Convene support team.

918e6428c53a2b77.description: About the Role NTT DATA is seeking an Information Security GRC Lead to join our team in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is for a seasoned subject matter expert responsible for leading the organization's information security governance, risk management, and compliance program. The lead will assess risks, implement security controls, ensure compliance, manage security awareness initiatives, and drive policy development. Role Context and Collaboration The Information Security GRC Lead will collaborate with business leaders, technology teams, auditors, and executive stakeholders. This collaboration is essential for strengthening security governance, managing enterprise risk, and maintaining a robust security posture across the organization. Key Responsibilities Lead the information security governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) team. Develop, maintain, and enforce information security policies, standards, and procedures. Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory, contractual, and industry security requirements. Lead internal security audits and coordinate remediation activities. Establish and report on security compliance metrics, key risk indicators, and governance dashboards to leadership. Lead security awareness and training programs across the organization. Drive the implementation and continuous improvement of security controls and best practices. Manage third-party security risk assessments and supplier compliance reviews. Present security risks, compliance status, and recommendations to governance committees and executive stakeholders. Provide leadership and mentorship to junior security and GRC team members. Act as the primary point of contact for information security governance, risk, and compliance matters. Monitor emerging threats, regulatory changes, and industry trends, incorporating them into the security program. Perform any other related task as required. Qualifications and Certifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field. Security certifications such as CISA, CRISC, COBIT, CISSP, CISM, or equivalent are preferred. Certifications such as ISO 27001 Lead Auditor and/or Lead Implementer are preferred. Required Experience Significant experience in Information Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) roles. Proven experience leading enterprise risk management and compliance programs. Experience managing internal and external audits. Experience working with executive stakeholders and governance committees. Experience leading, mentoring, or managing security and GRC professionals. Strong exposure to regulatory compliance, third-party risk management, and policy governance.

9103c683fc4eff37.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن الوحدات الخاصة للحراسات الأمنية عن توفر شاغر لوظيفة حارس أمن بدوام كامل في بلجرشي، الباحة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى حماية الممتلكات والحفاظ على النظام من خلال القيام بدوريات منتظمة ومراقبة أماكن العمل ومنافذ الدخول. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراقبة عمليات الدخول إلى المنشأة ومغادرتها، وإصدار التصاريح اللازمة. التحقق من هوية الموردين والزوار وتسجيل بياناتهم، وإصدار تصاريح الدخول لهم. القيام بدوريات منتظمة في أماكن العمل، وتفقد البوابات والأبواب والنوافذ لضمان سلامتها. المرور بين الزوار والموظفين للحفاظ على النظام وحماية الممتلكات، ونشر اللوائح الداخلية للمنشأة. الاستجابة الفورية للإنذارات والتحقيق في أي حوادث قد تقع. التواصل مع إدارات مكافحة الحرائق أو الإسعاف أو الشرطة عند الضرورة، وإبلاغ الإدارة المختصة. الالتزام التام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الحراسات الأمنية أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على العمل بدوام كامل. القدرة على مراقبة الأماكن والممتلكات بفعالية. بيئة العمل سيعمل حارس الأمن ضمن فريق الوحدات الخاصة للحراسات الأمنية في مدينة بلجرشي بمنطقة الباحة. يتطلب الدور اليقظة والانتباه المستمر لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة ومحمية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة الشخصية.

9139132c4ef7e294.description: About the Role AtkinsRéalis is seeking an experienced MEP Design Manager to lead and coordinate all Mechanical, Electrical, and Public Health design activities for a major mega-development project in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves delivering a combination of buildings, infrastructure, public realm, and landscape components. The successful candidate will ensure technical excellence, design integration, and regulatory compliance to meet project objectives and operational requirements. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage all MEP design activities across infrastructure and landscape developments, from concept through detailed design and construction support. Coordinate mechanical, electrical, public health, utility, and specialist design disciplines to ensure integrated project delivery. Manage design consultants and technical teams to deliver high-quality design packages in line with project schedules. Review and approve MEP calculations, reports, drawings, specifications, and technical submissions. Ensure compliance with project requirements, Saudi regulations, international standards, and authority approvals. Required Experience A minimum of 15 years of experience in MEP design management. 914f9255ac50cf52.description: About the Role JLL is seeking a Finance Officer to join our team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves supporting comprehensive financial operations for a premium residential resort located in North Riyadh. The Finance Officer will be essential in maintaining accurate financial records, processing transactions efficiently, and assisting the Finance Manager in delivering transparent and compliant financial reporting. Key Responsibilities Process vendor invoices, verify supporting documentation, and ensure compliance with approved budgets. Prepare payment instructions and coordinate with banking partners for timely processing. Maintain vendor master files, payment schedules, and contract documentation. Track outstanding payables and resolve invoice discrepancies. Support invoicing, receipting, and payment reconciliation processes. Process tenant payments, issue receipts, and maintain accurate payment records. Assist with deposit management and refund processing. Support the collection team with receivables documentation and reporting. Maintain accurate general ledger accounts and perform regular transaction reconciliations. Prepare daily cash position reports and monitor bank account activity. Reconcile utility invoices, meter readings, and tenant rebilling calculations. Ensure all financial records are complete, organized, and audit-ready. Reporting and Compliance Support Assist in the preparation of monthly management accounts and budget variance reports. Support cash flow forecasting and financial planning activities. Maintain organized electronic and physical filing systems for financial documentation. Provide data and documentation for internal and external audit processes. Ensure all transactions comply with Saudi Arabian tax regulations (VAT, e-invoicing, WHT). Support statutory filing requirements and compliance reporting. Maintain accurate documentation for audit trails and regulatory review. Implement and follow financial policies and internal control procedures. Coordination and Collaboration Interface with facilities management contractors on invoice verification and payment coordination. Collaborate with property, leasing, and operations teams on financial matters. Respond to internal queries regarding payments, invoices, and account status. Perform additional financial tasks as assigned by the Finance Manager. Experience Required Candidates should possess 3-5 years of relevant experience in finance or accounting roles.

91907ac97fc3f060.description: About Tabby Tabby is seeking a Risk Engineer I to join its growing Risk and Scoring teams. This full-time role is focused on contributing to the risk and financial modeling aspects of the Tabby product. Role Overview The Risk Engineer I will be responsible for the development and implementation of credit policies and risk assessment strategies. This position involves monitoring decision-making systems, assessing the impact of changes, and ensuring the technical integrity of credit decision-making processes. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement credit policies and risk assessment strategies in alignment with business customer requirements, specifically for the risk and antifraud departments. Monitor the operation of the decision-making system and evaluate the effectiveness of implemented changes. Develop and automate test scripts for system modifications, including testing algorithms and elements of the credit decision-making strategy. Conduct comprehensive analysis of the credit decision-making strategy from a technical implementation perspective, identifying and resolving errors. Perform additional responsibilities as assigned by management. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of relevant experience as an Engineer in tech or fintech products. Ability to operate effectively in a demanding startup environment. Work Environment This is a full-time position within a fast-paced startup environment, requiring adaptability and resilience. 91c5c4e88fa2b09a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المرافق المتحدة للمقاولات عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في بيشة، بمنطقة عسير. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومناسب للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، حيث سيتولى مسؤولية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية، ومتابعة التنفيذ، وتشخيص الأعطال، وإعداد برامج الصيانة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة مراحل التنفيذ. تجهيز مخططات ومواصفات خطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية، وتحديد مساراتها بدقة. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية، ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية، بناءً على توصيات الشركات المصنعة والتعليمات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر، ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية. معرفة جيدة بشبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال وإعداد برامج الصيانة. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الكهربائي ضمن فريق عمل في شركة المرافق المتحدة للمقاولات بمدينة بيشة، ويسهم في تنفيذ المشاريع الهندسية الكهربائية المختلفة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية موقع العمل: بيشة، عسير. نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه.

91e3a88638d3ef3d.job_title: Operations Analyst Cash Equity Brokerage support
91e3a88638d3ef3d.description: About the Role Citigroup Saudi Arabia is seeking an Operations Analyst to join its Cash Equity Brokerage team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves providing critical operational support to the equity trading desk, with a specific focus on the Saudi market. The position is central to ensuring the efficient processing of trades, managing client accounts, and mitigating operational risks within the dynamic financial markets of the Kingdom. Role Context and Objectives The Operations Analyst will support the MENA equity trading desk, contributing to the success of Citigroup Saudi Arabia in the region. The role requires a proactive approach to problem-solving and a commitment to operational excellence. Key objectives include maintaining smooth and efficient trade processing, ensuring accurate client account management, and actively participating in risk mitigation strategies. Key Responsibilities Provide dedicated operational support for all Saudi trading activities of the equity trading desk. Manage the end-to-end process of client account creation and maintenance. Coordinate with custodians for pre-confirmation of trades to ensure timely settlement. Handle client confirmations, ensuring accuracy and prompt delivery. Perform daily stock and cash reconciliations to identify and resolve discrepancies. Monitor commission payments and ensure correct calculation and processing. Engage in proactive risk management by identifying potential operational risks and implementing mitigation strategies. Deliver service to customers, addressing inquiries and resolving issues effectively. Contribute to business enablement by maintaining and enhancing operational excellence. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor's degree in Finance. Fluency in English (both written and spoken). Proficiency in Microsoft Excel. Required Skills and Competencies Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, enabling effective interaction with traders, clients, and custodians. A strong analytical mindset with a high level of attention to detail. Proven ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. Preferred Qualifications Previous experience in a brokerage or custody environment. An understanding of the specificities of Saudi Equity brokerage. Fluency in Arabic.

91ec3c0d608b2d8c.description: About the Role The البيت الأهلي للتمويل is seeking an Ijarah Development Manager to join their team in Jiddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring over 10 years of experience. Role Purpose The Ijarah Development Manager will be responsible for driving the growth of the Ijarah financing business. This involves cultivating strong relationships with car dealers and automotive vendors, expanding the company's vendor network, and implementing strategies to meet and exceed sales and business development objectives. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain strong relationships with car dealers, automotive vendors, and strategic partners. Identify and onboard new vendors to expand market reach and sales opportunities. Drive Ijarah sales growth through vendor-specific sales plans, promotional campaigns, and financing offers. Negotiate commercial agreements and establish mutually beneficial partnerships with vendors. Monitor vendor performance, sales pipelines, and conversion rates to achieve assigned targets. Coordinate with sales, credit, and operations teams to ensure smooth financing processes and excellent vendor service. 91182f10d28a5e6a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة آفاق الغذاء عن أخصائي تسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على تحديد الأهداف التسويقية وتطوير السياسات للسلع والخدمات، بالإضافة إلى الإشراف على تنفيذها وتقييمها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال التسويق، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد الأهداف التسويقية العامة والفرعية، وتطوير السياسات والخطط والبرامج التسويقية. تحليل دورة حياة المنتج لتحديد أسباب نجاح أو فشل تسويق المنتجات. تحليل أسعار المنافسين وتطوير سياسات تسعير تنافسية. تحديد برامج الترويج، واختيار قنوات التوزيع المناسبة، وتقييم فعالية الحملات الدعائية والإعلانية. وضع جداول زمنية لتنفيذ السياسات التسويقية، ومتابعة إجراءات التنفيذ وتقييم النتائج المحققة. إجراء اختبارات السوق للمنتجات الجديدة قبل طرحها النهائي، باستخدام برامج حاسوبية متخصصة وفقاً لمتطلبات العمل. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالتسويق، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال التسويق. القدرة على تحديد الأهداف التسويقية وتطوير السياسات. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم دورة حياة المنتج وأسعار المنافسين. القدرة على استخدام برامج حاسوبية خاصة باختبارات السوق. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي التسويق بدوام كامل ضمن فريق آفاق الغذاء في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل داعمة تساهم في تحقيق الأهداف التسويقية. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. المنطقة: المنطقة الشرقية، الدمام. الراتب: غير معلن.

9125d2e23e8f6598.description: About Algihaz Holding Algihaz Holding is a prominent engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) company in Saudi Arabia, with over 45 years of experience. The company specializes in delivering engineering design and construction services for infrastructure and essential services. Job Summary Algihaz Holding is seeking an Electrical Program Manager to oversee and coordinate a portfolio of 3 to 5 projects simultaneously. This full-time role is based in Makkah, specifically covering projects in Jeddah and Makkah. The Program Manager will ensure all projects are executed according to contractual requirements, approved budgets, quality standards, safety regulations, and agreed timelines. Key Responsibilities Oversee 3-5 projects concurrently, ensuring alignment with company objectives, contractual commitments, budgets, schedules, quality, and safety requirements. Lead, guide, and develop Project Managers, ensuring accountability for project delivery and agreed targets. Review execution strategies, baseline schedules, milestones, and recovery plans; resolve delays and cross-project dependencies. Monitor budgets, actual costs, forecasts, profitability, and cost-to-complete estimates; support budget revisions and funding requests. Oversee invoicing, progress claims, receivables, supplier payments, and cash flow in coordination with Finance and Cost Control. Manage contractual obligations, scope changes, variations, claims, and extensions of time to protect company interests. Coordinate manpower forecasting, mobilization, allocation, transfers, and demobilization; resolve resource conflicts across projects. Ensure compliance with Saudization and Labor Compliance requirements, including workforce deployment and compensation commitments. Coordinate procurement and logistics to ensure timely availability of materials, equipment, and machinery; address supply constraints. Qualifications and Requirements A minimum of 10 years of experience in program or project management, preferably within the EPC sector. Candidates must be located in Saudi Arabia. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously. Work Location This position is based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, with responsibilities covering projects in both Jeddah and Makkah. Application Process Qualified candidates are invited to apply for this full-time Electrical Program Manager position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

912a6d17b2fa00e9.description: About Jumeirah Hotels and Resorts Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates a portfolio of 29 properties across 11 countries in the Middle East, Europe, and Asia. Since 1999, with the opening of Jumeirah Burj Al Arab, the brand has been recognized for its beachfront resorts, city hotels, and residences. Jumeirah is known for its service and for crafting experiences for guests worldwide. About the Role Jumeirah The Red Sea is seeking a Director Finance to join its team. This is a full-time position responsible for overseeing financial operations and contributing to strategic financial planning within the organization. Key Responsibilities Ensure accurate maintenance of financial records, compliance with accounting standards, and adherence to legal and regulatory requirements, including the preparation and review of financial statements. Establish robust cash management controls, prepare cash flow forecasts, and oversee reconciliations of balance sheet accounts to ensure accuracy and identify discrepancies. Supervise the Finance and Accounting department, ensuring smooth operations and timely delivery of financial reports, while also providing training and development opportunities to enhance team skills. Direct the preparation of annual budgets and monthly forecasts, establish major financial objectives and policies, and conduct analysis to minimize variances and maximize return on investment. Contribute financial insights and recommendations to strategic planning processes, establish functional objectives aligned with organizational goals, and prepare long-term capital and operational projections. Maintain professional relationships with stakeholders such as owners, asset managers, and corporate teams, reporting on financial performance, acting as a business advisor, and addressing specific requirements. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in finance. Demonstrated ability to manage financial records and ensure compliance with accounting and regulatory standards. Experience in cash management, forecasting, and balance sheet reconciliation. Proven leadership skills to supervise and develop a finance and accounting team. Proficiency in budget preparation, financial forecasting, and variance analysis. Ability to contribute financial insights to strategic planning and establish functional objectives. Strong interpersonal skills for managing relationships with various stakeholders. Work Type This is a full-time position. Application Process Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon inquiry.

912d20b3445bc129.description: About the Role Avalon Pharma (Middle East Pharmaceutical Industries) is seeking a Demand Planning Specialist to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position focused on managing and optimizing demand planning processes within the company. Role Overview The Demand Planning Specialist will be responsible for contributing to the strategic planning and forecasting of product demand. This role involves working to ensure efficient supply chain operations and product availability to meet market needs. Responsibilities Develop and maintain demand forecasts for various products. Analyze historical data and market trends to improve forecast accuracy. Collaborate with sales, marketing, and supply chain teams to gather relevant information for planning. Monitor inventory levels and work to prevent stockouts or overstock situations. Prepare reports on demand planning performance and key metrics. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor's Degree. Proven experience in demand planning or a related field. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Proficiency in relevant planning software and tools. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within the operations of Avalon Pharma (Middle East Pharmaceutical Industries). The role operates within a professional environment focused on pharmaceutical industry standards and practices. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified qualifications are encouraged to apply for this Demand Planning Specialist position.

914533cafa32b77c.description: About the Role Delta Hotels and Resorts® is seeking a Bellstand Supervisor to join our team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is responsible for overseeing bellstand operations and ensuring exceptional guest service. The role involves direct guest interaction, luggage assistance, and supporting the management team in various departmental functions. Key Responsibilities Greet guests, provide information on property amenities, services, hours of operation, and local attractions. Open doors and assist guests/visitors entering and leaving the property. Manage luggage storage and retrieval, and transport guest luggage to and from rooms or designated areas. Assist guests/visitors with vehicle entry and exit, including loading and unloading luggage. Provide directions and arrange transportation (*, taxi, shuttle, limousine) for guests, recording advance requests. Dispatch bell staff or valet staff as needed and communicate parking procedures to guests. Follow up with guests to ensure satisfaction with requests or problem resolution. Serve as a departmental role model and assist management with hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, motivating, and coaching employees. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with colleagues. Operational Duties and Standards Adhere to all company policies and procedures, reporting accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to management. Maintain awareness of undesirable persons on property premises. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, and maintain confidentiality of proprietary information. Welcome and acknowledge all guests, anticipate and address service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and express genuine appreciation. Communicate using clear and professional language, and answer telephones with appropriate etiquette. Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards. Physical Requirements Ability to read and visually verify information in various formats (*, small print). Capability to move at a speed required to respond to work situations (*, run, walk, jog). Ability to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods or an entire work shift. Capable of moving, lifting, carrying, pushing, pulling, and placing objects weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance, and objects exceeding 75 pounds with assistance. Proficiency in grasping, turning, and manipulating objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Ability to move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces, as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Capability to reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 year of relevant experience is required for this role. Demonstrated ability to perform the physical requirements of the position. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Makkah, with operations also extending to Jeddah. The Bellstand Supervisor will work within a dynamic hospitality environment, directly interacting with guests and supporting a dedicated team.

91b0b27e99166fa7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة فاد الخليجيه للمقاولات عن فني شبكات اتصالات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ضمان التشغيل الفعال لشبكات الاتصالات، بما في ذلك تمديد الأسلاك وتوصيل المعدات وصيانة الأنظمة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تمديد الأسلاك وتوصيل المعدات اللازمة لتشغيل الشبكات. ضمان تشغيل الهواتف والإنترنت بشكل سليم. توصيل كافة الأسلاك داخل المباني وخارجها. إعداد التقارير الدورية للمسؤول المباشر حول حالة الشبكات والأعمال المنجزة. المهام التشغيلية تطبيق المعرفة بأنظمة الإرسال والبث والتبديل والتحكم في تشغيل أنظمة الاتصالات. متابعة مشاكل الشبكة والعمل على حلها تحت إشراف مهندس الشبكة. إجراء الصيانة الروتينية لمعدات وأدوات الشبكة وتحديد نوع الصيانة اللازمة وتوقيتها. اختبار المعدات التي تم إصلاحها أو تثبيتها حديثًا أو تحديثها للتأكد من عملها بشكل صحيح ومطابقتها للمواصفات. اختبار الدوائر ومكونات معدات الاتصالات السلكية واللاسلكية المعطلة لتحديد مصادر الأعطال وإصلاحها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال شبكات الاتصالات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على فهم وتطبيق مبادئ الإرسال والبث والتبديل والتحكم في أنظمة الاتصالات. مهارات جيدة في استكشاف الأخطاء وإصلاحها. بيئة العمل يعمل فني شبكات الاتصالات ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة فاد الخليجيه للمقاولات، ويقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بمهام الصيانة والتركيب داخل وخارج المباني. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في الرياض.

91dbab4c193edd08.description: The Senior Network Engineer will be responsible for designing, implementing, managing, and maintaining the bank's enterprise network infrastructure to ensure secure, reliable, and high-performance network connectivity across data centers, branches, and corporate environments. The ideal candidate must have extensive experience in enterprise networking within the banking sector, with strong expertise in network architecture, security, troubleshooting, and high-availability network solutions. Key Responsibilities Design, implement, configure, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure. Manage and support LAN, WAN, WLAN, and data center networking environments. Configure and administer network devices, including routers, switches, firewalls, and load balancers. Implement and maintain routing and switching protocols, including BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, and VLANs. Manage network security, segmentation, access control, and firewall policies. Monitor network performance, identify potential issues, and ensure network availability and reliability. Troubleshoot complex network incidents and perform root cause analysis. Manage VPN technologies, site-to-site connectivity, and secure remote access solutions. Support network infrastructure across banking branches, headquarters, and data centers. Participate in network upgrades, migrations, capacity planning, and infrastructure transformation projects. Ensure network infrastructure compliance with banking security policies and regulatory requirements. Coordinate with cybersecurity, systems, and application teams to resolve network-related issues. Maintain network documentation, topology diagrams, configuration backups, and operational procedures. Support business continuity and disaster recovery initiatives related to network infrastructure. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Minimum 8 years of experience in network engineering and enterprise networking. Previous experience working in the banking or financial services sector is mandatory. Strong hands-on experience with Cisco or equivalent enterprise networking technologies. Excellent knowledge of routing and switching protocols (BGP, OSPF, VLANs, STP). Experience with enterprise firewalls, VPNs, and network security solutions. Knowledge of load balancing, network segmentation, and high-availability architectures. Experience supporting data center and multi-site network environments. Strong troubleshooting and network performance optimization skills. Understanding of network security standards and banking regulatory requirements. Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.

918a443e71b71e62.description: نبحث عن مساعد معلم تربية خاصة شغوف وملتزم لدعم بيئة تعليمية محفزة وداعمة للأطفال. ستكون مسؤولاً عن مساعدة المعلم الرئيسي في تنفيذ الخطط التعليمية وتقديم الدعم الفردي للطلاب ذوي الاحتياجات الخاصة. انضم إلى فريقنا المتخصص وساهم في إحداث فرق إيجابي في حياة أطفالنا. المهام والمسؤوليات: * مساعدة المعلم الرئيسي في إعداد وتنفيذ الدروس والأنشطة التعليمية. * تقديم الدعم الفردي للطلاب حسب خططهم التعليمية الفردية. * مراقبة تقدم الطلاب وسلوكهم وتقديم تقارير منتظمة. * المساعدة في الحفاظ على بيئة صفية آمنة ومنظمة. * التعاون مع فريق العمل وأولياء الأمور لدعم احتياجات الطلاب.

912e2005a526216a.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Golf - Senior PGA Teaching Professional. This full-time role serves as the most senior coach at Qiddiya Golf during Phase 1, upholding the club’s instructional standards. The incumbent will deliver world-class coaching to members, guests, juniors, and aspiring elite players, leading the Golf Academy’s day-to-day program and mentoring other teaching professionals. The position requires 8-10 years of experience. Role Purpose and Context The Senior PGA Teaching Professional is responsible for establishing Qiddiya Golf as the benchmark for golf instruction in the Kingdom from its inception. Until the permanent clubhouse opens in 2028 and a Director of Instruction is appointed, this role holds the instructional leadership of the club. This includes designing and delivering the coaching curriculum, setting lesson standards, building player pathways, and ensuring a high-quality experience for every guest. The role combines a substantial personal coaching load with the daily leadership of the teaching team, working closely with Golf Operations, Retail, Events, Golf Saudi, and the Saudi Golf Federation on various development initiatives aligned with Saudi Vision 2030. Key Responsibilities Deliver a full weekly schedule of private lessons, playing lessons, short-game sessions, and on-course coaching, tailored to individual player needs. Coach discerning clientele, including VIPs, low-handicap golfers, and visiting dignitaries, with discretion and professionalism. Develop individual development plans for regular students, tracking goals, swing data, practice plans, and progress. Lead high-performance coaching for elite juniors and aspiring amateur players. Design, launch, and refine the academy curriculum, including beginner pathways, ladies’ programs, junior academy levels, short-game schools, and performance squads. Manage the daily coaching calendar and booking flow, ensuring alignment with demand and facility availability. Set and audit the club’s "Qiddiya Coaching Standard" for lesson structure, communication, follow-up, punctuality, and presentation. Develop academy packages, golf schools, and corporate golf clinics in partnership with Sales and Events. Lead, mentor, and evaluate PGA Teaching Professionals and Assistant Professionals through observations and feedback. Conduct internal coaching workshops and continuing professional development to ensure a consistent instructional philosophy. Support the Golf Academy’s Saudi national development and mentor Saudi PGA trainees and assistant coaches as required. Contribute to the recruitment, onboarding, and rostering of the coaching team. Act as the club’s lead specialist for launch monitors, 3D motion capture, pressure plates, putting analysis, and video systems. Ensure teaching studios, simulators, and range technology are calibrated, maintained, and immaculately presented. Conduct custom club-fitting sessions in partnership with Retail. Integrate fitness and mobility screening into player assessments, liaising with external specialists when appropriate. Achieve agreed academy revenue, lesson utilization, and student retention targets. Monitor guest feedback and lesson satisfaction scores, resolving concerns promptly. Contribute to the academy budget, pricing proposals, and recommend investments in coaching technology. Lead the junior academy, including safeguarding compliance and structured progression. Champion the growth of women’s and family golf through culturally considerate programs. Collaborate with Golf Saudi and the Saudi Golf Federation on grassroots initiatives. Support club competitions, pro-ams, and tournament events. Document academy processes, curricula, and student records for seamless handover. Provide practical input into the design of permanent academy facilities. Undertake additional duties as required to support organizational objectives. Core Competencies Bespoke Coaching Mastery: Ability to adapt coaching methods to individual learning styles, from beginners to elite amateurs. Luxury Service Mindset: Delivers a 5-star experience, characterized by punctuality, immaculate presentation, discretion, and attention to detail. Mentorship & Leadership: Elevates the coaching team's standards through example, observation, and constructive feedback. Communication & Cultural Intelligence: Explains complex concepts clearly and builds respectful relationships with diverse clientele. Commercial Awareness: Understands lesson utilization, retention, and identifies opportunities for academy growth. Attention to Detail: Identifies and resolves minor flaws in swings, data, or teaching bays proactively. Innovation & Continuous Learning: Stays current with coaching science and technology, bringing fresh ideas to the academy. Resilience & Stamina: Maintains energy, composure, and enthusiasm during long coaching days in the Saudi climate. Experience Required Candidates should possess 8-10 years of relevant experience in golf instruction and leadership roles. Work Type This is a full-time position.

91f0b36fb98f7c0e.description: About Sephora and the Role Sephora is seeking a Client Experience Coach to join its team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, with responsibilities covering Jeddah and Makkah. This is a full-time position requiring 2-5 years of experience. The role focuses on supporting Retail Education initiatives across Sephora KSA, contributing to the continuous development of retail employees, and enhancing the overall client experience. Role Purpose and Focus The Client Experience Coach promotes and embodies the Sephora Attitude in both training and on the shop floor. A strong focus is placed on omni-channel excellence, employee career development, and capability building. The role also supports regional category training, the Sephorization of Brand BAs, and the sharing of Sephora Collection knowledge to strengthen expertise and consistency across the retail network. Key Responsibilities Manage onboarding for all new joiners, including organizing and delivering 1-day welcoming training, onboarding training, and coaching/development at the store level. Conduct daily store visits, ensuring 100% store coverage quarterly (monthly for flagship and top 10 KSA stores) or as business needs dictate. Follow up on all retail topics such as Sephora Attitude, My Sephora, cross-selling, Buddy skills, Love Meter, and Mystery Shopper. Support Retail Training by coaching and following up on retail education and project initiatives. Align with Retail Managers/Supervisors on priority stores and business needs. Assess store teams on performance at least once a year or as business requires. Focus on and follow up on Ramadan, Festive, and thematic animation trainings. Follow up on knowledge retention after training attendance for all Retail trainings, Induction, and Sephora Collection. Support knowledge and training at the store level for all Sephora Collection new launches, core products, and animations. Training Delivery and Coaching Deliver onboarding training and support the delivery of other retail topics. Manage Brand BA training delivery and logistics. Provide follow-up and coaching for new joiners (in-store and digital). Conduct follow-up and coaching on Sephora Collection in-store training. Monitor Brand BA training attendance and coordinate with Store Managers for scheduling. Perform on-the-floor coaching, assessment, and feedback for all retail trainings. Support engagement and participation in the Digital Learning Platform. Work Environment and Culture At Sephora, the work environment fosters a community where authenticity is embraced, and diverse strengths contribute to a collective spirit. The culture emphasizes empowerment, learning, and growth, providing tools, space, and opportunities for innovation and leadership. The role offers work that brings fulfillment, from delighting clients daily to inspiring the industry. Application Information This full-time position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Salary details are not disclosed. Join Sephora and contribute to a beautiful experience.

916a82710d2e851f.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مكتب طريق الفرسان لتأجير السيارات عن أخصائي عمليات موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقه في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تنفيذ ومراقبة الإجراءات المتعلقة بدوام الموظفين وإجازاتهم، بالإضافة إلى التعامل مع استفساراتهم وشكواهم بمهنية عالية. يهدف الدور إلى ضمان تطبيق سياسات وإجراءات الموارد البشرية بكفاءة ودقة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة والنماذج الخاصة بمراقبة دوام موظفي الفروع وإجازاتهم بمختلف أنواعها، وتعديل النماذج حسب الحاجة. تطبيق نظام مراقبة الحضور والتأكد من التزام الموظفين بأوقات الدوام الرسمي. تطبيق سياسات وإجراءات الإجازات السنوية والمرضية والطارئة وغيرها من الإجازات المحددة في سياسة العطل والإجازات المعتمدة. تطبيق إجراءات الترقيات والإعارة وانتهاء الخدمة، وتسجيل كافة وقوعات الموظفين وفقاً للأنظمة والإجراءات المعتمدة. التعامل مع شكاوى وملاحظات وطلبات واستفسارات الموظفين بطريقة مهنية، ورفع المشاكل إلى مدير الإدارة عند الضرورة. تحديث المعلومات المتعلقة بالموظفين وتزويدها لفريق خدمات الموظفين، بما في ذلك تسجيل وتوثيق الترقيات والدورات التدريبية والأمور المتعلقة بالرواتب والامتيازات. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بعمليات الموارد البشرية، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال عمليات الموارد البشرية. فهم عميق لإجراءات وأنظمة الموارد البشرية. القدرة على التعامل مع شكاوى واستفسارات الموظفين بمهنية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في التواصل الشفهي والكتابي. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في تحديث البيانات وحفظها. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتعاون الفعال. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص في الموارد البشرية لدعم عمليات الشركة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات للتقديم على هذه الوظيفة.

91d3637166089c97.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة كلاسي إنوفايشنز عن حاجتها لتوظيف مهندس معماري داخلي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. سيعمل شاغل الوظيفة في معرض الأثاث، حيث يتولى مسؤولية تقديم الاستشارات التصميمية للعملاء وإعداد التصميمات الداخلية وتوزيع الأثاث. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال العملاء وفهم احتياجاتهم ومتطلباتهم التصميمية. إعداد التصميمات الداخلية وتوزيع الأثاث بما يتناسب مع أبعاد المساحات المتاحة. إنشاء تصورات ثلاثية الأبعاد ومخططات تنفيذية ثنائية وثلاثية الأبعاد. اختيار الأثاث والخامات والألوان والتشطيبات المناسبة لكل تصميم. تقديم العروض والتصورات التصميمية للعملاء وإجراء التعديلات المطلوبة بناءً على ملاحظاتهم. إعداد المقاسات والمواصفات الفنية اللازمة لعمليات التصنيع والتوريد. التنسيق الفعال مع أقسام المبيعات والتصنيع والتركيب لضمان تنفيذ التصميمات المعتمدة بدقة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة المعمارية الداخلية. القدرة على إعداد التصميمات الداخلية وتوزيع الأثاث بفعالية. مهارة في إعداد التصورات ثلاثية الأبعاد والمخططات التنفيذية. معرفة جيدة بالخامات والألوان والتشطيبات المختلفة. متطلبات التقديم يجب على المتقدمين تقديم ملف أعمال سابقة (Portfolio) يوضح خبراتهم ومهاراتهم التصميمية. بيئة العمل سيعمل المهندس المعماري الداخلي ضمن فريق شركة كلاسي إنوفايشنز في الرياض، في بيئة معرض أثاث ديناميكية تتطلب التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء والأقسام الداخلية لضمان تحقيق أفضل النتائج التصميمية والتنفيذية. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل.

Escalate defects that require major repair or replacement assessment to the appropriate channels. Prepare comprehensive technical reports, including photographic evidence and inspection results. Update relevant systems and follow up on assigned cases to ensure resolution. Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction and achieve assigned Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). 9103a73fa11d6b40.description: About the Role National Contracting Co Ltd is seeking a Heavy Vehicle Maintenance Supervisor to join our team in Al Khobar, Eastern Province. This full-time role is central to ensuring the optimal performance and reliability of our vehicle fleet. The supervisor will oversee the maintenance and repair of heavy vehicles, directly contributing to operational efficiency and minimizing downtime. Role Overview The Heavy Vehicle Maintenance Supervisor leads a dedicated team, fostering a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement within the maintenance department. This position requires expertise in vehicle maintenance to uphold high standards and ensure consistent service delivery. The role involves developing leadership skills and collaborating with skilled technicians and mechanics. Key Responsibilities Oversee daily maintenance and repair activities for heavy vehicles, ensuring efficiency and adherence to safety standards to minimize operational downtime. Lead and support a team of technicians, providing guidance in troubleshooting complex mechanical issues and promoting skill development. Develop and implement preventative maintenance schedules aligned with industry best practices to enhance vehicle longevity and performance. Monitor inventory levels of parts and supplies, coordinating with suppliers for timely procurement and availability of essential components. Conduct regular vehicle inspections to identify potential issues proactively and ensure compliance with safety regulations and company policies. Prepare detailed reports on maintenance activities, vehicle performance, and team productivity to inform management decisions and drive improvements. Train and mentor junior staff, sharing knowledge of best practices and techniques to enhance their skills and support career growth. Collaborate with other departments to align maintenance activities with overall business objectives and contribute to strategic planning. Stay updated on industry trends and advancements in vehicle technology, integrating new techniques and tools to improve maintenance processes. Qualifications and Experience Proven experience in heavy vehicle maintenance and repair. 3-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated leadership abilities to guide and support a team of technicians. Strong understanding of preventative maintenance principles and safety standards. Work Environment This position operates within a collaborative team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and innovation. The company is committed to providing a supportive atmosphere for professional and personal growth, offering training programs and workshops to advance careers in vehicle maintenance and supervision. Application Process We invite qualified candidates to apply for this opportunity to make a significant impact on our operations. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

915e0b5b903841d6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اليمامة للأعمال التجارية والمقاولات عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات للمشاريع الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى تطوير برامج التجميع والتركيب والتشغيل والصيانة الوقائية للمعدات والتجهيزات الصناعية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات التفصيلية لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات توزيع أنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. تصميم برامج تشغيل المعدات الصناعية وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية، مع الالتزام بتعليمات الشركات المصنعة ومتابعة تنفيذها. المساهمة في تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوثيق نسب التقدم، وعرضها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات الداخلية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية بدقة. معرفة قوية ببرامج تجميع وتركيب وتشغيل وصيانة التجهيزات والمعدات الميكانيكية. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الميكانيكي ضمن فريق متخصص في مكة المكرمة، في بيئة عمل ديناميكية تركز على تنفيذ المشاريع الهندسية بكفاءة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. المهارات الشخصية مهارات ممتازة في التخطيط والتنظيم. القدرة على حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرارات الفنية. مهارات تواصل فعالة لإعداد التقارير وعرضها. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة الشخصية.

918b9b5fa186cf16.job_title: Demi Chef De Partie The EDITION
918b9b5fa186cf16.description: About the Role Sheraton Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Demi Chef to join its culinary team in Medina, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position requires 2-5 years of experience in a similar role and focuses on preparing high-quality meals while maintaining kitchen standards and supporting team operations. Key Responsibilities Prepare special meals or substitute items as required. Regulate the temperature of ovens, broilers, grills, and roasters to ensure proper cooking. Manage food thawing processes by pulling items from freezer storage to thaw in the refrigerator. Ensure proper portioning, arrangement, and garnishing of all food items. Maintain accurate food logs and monitor the quality and quantity of prepared food. Communicate assistance needed during busy periods and inform the Chef of excess food items for daily specials. Inform Food & Beverage service staff about menu specials and out-of-stock items. Prepare and cook food according to established recipes, quality standards, presentation standards, and food preparation checklists. Prepare cold food items as needed. Operational Support and Team Collaboration Assist management in various human resources functions including hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, motivating, and coaching employees. Serve as a role model for other team members. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with colleagues and support the team in achieving common goals. Listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Compliance and Safety Adhere to all company and safety and security policies and procedures. Report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to the manager. Complete all required safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional. Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards in all tasks. Physical Requirements and Work Environment Ability to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods of time. Capability to reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Anticipate and address guests’ service needs with clear and professional communication. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors. Qualifications 2-5 years of experience in a culinary role, preferably as a Demi Chef. Demonstrated ability to prepare and cook a variety of food items. Strong understanding of food safety and hygiene standards. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced kitchen environment.

91b09da47d8694f0.description: About Chalhoub Group Chalhoub Group is a leading partner in the luxury goods sector across the Middle East, with over 600 stores and 300 brands. With more than 65 years of regional experience, the Group is a key player in the beauty, fashion, and gift sectors, providing services to partners and customers. Chalhoub Group is transitioning from a traditional distributor and luxury retail entity in the Middle East to a hybrid retail enterprise, making luxury product experiences accessible to customers everywhere. To support its next phase of growth, Chalhoub Group aims to build a world-class team and leverage technology and data in the continuous development of all aspects of its operations, from traditional retail to supply chain and customer loyalty. The Group seeks top talent to join its journey in exploring new horizons. Fashion Advisor Role As a Fashion Advisor at Chalhoub Group, you will be responsible for achieving individual and overall sales targets while providing an exceptional guest experience. This full-time position is based in Al Khobar, Eastern Region, and requires 0-1 years of experience. You will also support key customer and employee-related initiatives within the store, including client relationship management and customer experiences. Key Responsibilities Collect data on customer behavior, best-selling, and least-selling products, which will be a key component in business reviews. Enhance customer relationships through a comprehensive, omnichannel approach. Provide product feedback and information to the customer before purchase. Improve the Employee Net Promoter Score (eNPS) through employee initiatives, culture, and experiences. Ensure compliance with visual merchandising guidelines and standard operating procedures. Ensure that online purchases and in-store pickups are processed according to Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Ensure customer data is captured as per marketing team requirements. Promote the MUSE loyalty program and stay informed about app offers and other digital initiatives. Support in-store marketing activations. Stay updated on all brand social media activities and campaigns. Drive in-store sales. Support in-store customer experience initiatives. Provide feedback on effective and ineffective in-store practices. Qualifications and Experience Experience in sales or customer service with luxury retail brands is preferred. Career Development and Benefits Chalhoub Group supports employees in shaping their career journeys through diverse experiences, learning opportunities, and internal mobility. The Group offers various career paths for individuals. Chalhoub Group values its employees and provides a competitive benefits package, including healthcare, child education contributions, remote work policies, flexible work arrangements, and exclusive employee discounts. Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion Chalhoub Group believes that inspiring and delighting customers depends on diversity—intellectual, cultural, and constructive differences in abilities and perspectives. The Group is committed to the principles of inclusion and diversity in all its operations. All candidates are encouraged to apply and become part of the future of Chalhoub Group. Applications are reviewed based on merit and equal opportunity, regardless of gender, age, race, religion, or origin, with a continuous focus on leveraging the competencies of individuals with determination.

9125de21ae6f3923.description: About the Role ACWA Power is seeking an HSSE Supervisor to support the implementation, monitoring, and enforcement of Health, Safety, Security, and Environment (HSSE) activities within the plant. This full-time role involves taking necessary actions to prevent harm to people, equipment, and the environment, while ensuring compliance with legal requirements, organizational standards, and contractual obligations. The position requires 3-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Provide support in assessing risks and reviewing key operational activities to identify and prevent HSSE hazards. Attend meetings with contractors, sub-contractors, and vendors to advise on HSSE management and performance, ensuring adherence to defined standards. Assist in implementing the Plant’s HSSE management system, including emergency preparedness, to conform to ACWA NOMAC standards and legal requirements. Conduct daily site HSSE tours, monitoring performance and compliance with HSSE policies and procedures. Develop daily and monthly HSSE reports, highlighting incidents, concerns, and issues for timely escalation and resolution. Support the implementation of the work permit system, ensuring proper measures are taken before work commencement to maintain safe work areas. Assist in delivering HSSE training to ensure employees and contractor staff are aware of HSSE standards and management systems. Advise contractors on HSSE standards to promote awareness and best practices. Assist in implementing HSSE campaigns to disseminate proper HSSE culture across all staff. Maintain positive working relationships with regulators, emergency services, contractors, and local authorities to ensure mutual support and compliance. Assist in developing emergency drill scenarios and conducting site emergency mock drills to check readiness. Report and respond immediately to HSSE incidents using established communication channels to minimize damages. Participate in investigations for reportable HSSE incidents, contributing to root cause identification and recommending corrective actions. Monitor PPE inventory, raise purchase requests, and follow up to ensure timely availability of required goods. Adhere to all relevant organizational and departmental policies, processes, and procedures. Contribute to identifying and implementing change initiatives, programs, and projects. Qualifications and Experience 3-5 years of experience in a relevant HSSE role. Demonstrated ability to support HSSE implementation and enforcement activities. Understanding of legal requirements, organizational standards, and contractual obligations related to HSSE. Communication and Working Relationships Internally, the HSSE Supervisor will work closely with colleagues in the maintenance and operations departments, ensuring coordination with other departments across the plant organization, particularly maintenance and HSE. Externally, the role involves coordination with local stakeholders and grid operators. Work Type This is a full-time position. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

9135970e7b566024.description: About Measurement Methods Technology Company Measurement Methods Technology (MMT) specializes in the design and delivery of precision measurement devices and advanced technological solutions across various industries. The company focuses on innovation, accuracy, and reliability to support customers in enhancing their operational performance and decision-making processes. MMT integrates engineering expertise with modern digital tools to create high-quality products and services, fostering a technology-driven environment that values problem-solving, continuous learning, and customer-centric approaches. About the Digital Marketing Role MMT is seeking a Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Specialist to join the team in Al Khobar. This is a full-time, on-site position. The specialist will be responsible for enhancing and managing the company’s comprehensive digital presence, online marketing activities, product positioning, and e-commerce operations for MMT’s precision measurement and industrial technology solutions. The role requires 1-2 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Plan, execute, and optimize digital marketing campaigns across multiple channels. Manage and improve company branding and online presence. Handle social media marketing, content scheduling, and audience engagement. Support internal company marketing activities and process improvements. Manage email marketing campaigns and automation workflows. Coordinate with internal departments to align marketing with product positioning and sales objectives. E-commerce and Website Management Manage and optimize the company's Shopify store. Update products, technical specifications, product images, and datasheets. Improve website structure, navigation, and user experience (UI/UX). Create and optimize landing pages for campaigns and product categories. Maintain website content accuracy and overall digital consistency. Required Skills and Experience The role requires a combination of technical marketing expertise, SEO optimization, e-commerce management, and analytical thinking. Candidates should possess an understanding of industrial and electronic products. The specialist will collaborate closely with management, sales, and technical teams to enhance digital performance, increase brand visibility, and generate qualified leads. 1-2 years of experience in digital marketing or e-commerce. Proficiency in planning and executing digital marketing campaigns. Experience with social media and email marketing. Familiarity with e-commerce platforms, particularly Shopify. Knowledge of SEO optimization, website structure, and UI/UX principles. Work Environment This is a full-time, on-site position based in Al Khobar. The successful candidate will work within a collaborative, technology-driven environment that values problem-solving and continuous learning.

916166efc097541d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة النخلات الثلاث للتجاره عن فني كهربائي أنظمة حماية كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. يركز الدور على دراسة المخططات التنفيذية لأنظمة الحماية الكهربائية، وتحديد المواد اللازمة، ومتابعة أعمال التركيب والتشغيل والصيانة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة المخططات التنفيذية لأنظمة الحماية الكهربائية وأجهزة العد والقياس بدقة. تحديد الكميات المطلوبة من المواد والأجهزة اللازمة للعمل، ومطابقة مواصفاتها الفنية، وتأمينها. متابعة الإجراءات التنفيذية لأعمال التركيب والتشغيل والصيانة لأنظمة الحماية الكهربائية وأجهزة العد والقياس. تشخيص الأعطال في أنظمة الحماية الكهربائية وأجهزة العد والقياس، وتحديد أسبابها الجذرية، ومراقبة عمليات الصيانة. تطبيق جميع إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال أنظمة الحماية الكهربائية. فهم قوي للمخططات التنفيذية والرسومات الفنية المتعلقة بالأنظمة الكهربائية. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال وتحديد أسبابها بدقة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات فنية ممتازة في تركيب وتشغيل وصيانة أنظمة الحماية الكهربائية. الالتزام بتطبيق معايير السلامة والصحة المهنية. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. بيئة العمل يعمل فني كهربائي أنظمة الحماية الكهربائية في مدينة مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق مجموعة النخلات الثلاث للتجاره. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع لتنفيذ المهام الموكلة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

9197f2ce49ebceaf.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات عن فني إطفاء للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة راس تنورة. يركز هذا الدور على دراسة وتتبع مخططات الإطفاء، وإعداد الخطط اللازمة، ومراقبة التنفيذ لضمان أعلى معايير السلامة المهنية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتتبع المخططات الهندسية المعدة لعمليات الإطفاء المختلفة. إعداد قوائم تفصيلية بالمواد والأدوات والمعدات اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال الإطفاء. تطوير خطط الإطفاء ومراقبة تنفيذها لضمان الفعالية، بالإضافة إلى ضبط العمليات التشغيلية. إعداد جداول زمنية لتنفيذ أعمال الإطفاء وتوزيع المهام على فريق العمل. تطبيق جميع إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية بدقة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الإطفاء أو مجال ذي صلة. فهم جيد لمخططات الإطفاء وأنظمة السلامة. القدرة على إعداد قوائم المواد والمعدات اللازمة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية وتخطيطية ممتازة. القدرة على مراقبة العمليات وضبطها. الالتزام الصارم بإجراءات السلامة المهنية. مهارات التواصل الفعال لتوزيع المهام على المرؤوسين. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات في راس تنورة، المنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب العمل الالتزام بتطبيق معايير السلامة والجودة في جميع المهام الموكلة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

91dc1e2f357f1712.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المصباح للاتصالات عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتنفيذ سياسات واستراتيجيات المبيعات، وتقييم الأداء، وإعداد التقارير المتخصصة لضمان تحقيق الأهداف البيعية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة ومتابعة تطورات السوق لتحديد وتطوير الأهداف التسويقية وطرق البيع، وتقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع، وترجمة الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية واضحة. اقتراح سياسات البيع، ومتابعة تنفيذ السياسات والطرق البيعية، بالإضافة إلى وضع وتقييم البرامج الترويجية. التواصل الفعال مع العملاء لتحديد مشكلاتهم واحتياجاتهم، ومتابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية لتجنب المخاطر المستقبلية المحتملة. تقييم نتائج أداء مندوبي البيع، وتقييم مدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية المحددة، واقتراح الخطط والإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو ما يعادله. القدرة على تحليل بيانات السوق وتحديد الفرص. مهارات تواصل ممتازة وبناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء. بيئة العمل والمزايا هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في المدينة المنورة. يتم تقديم راتب شهري قدره 4100 ريال سعودي، بالإضافة إلى عمولات وحوافز شهرية بناءً على الأداء. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في المصباح للاتصالات.

91f8eaa05a54dee0.description: About the Role Panda Retail Company – Savola Group is seeking a Senior Compound Supervisor to oversee the daily operations of its company compounds in the Eastern region of Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is critical for ensuring that accommodation facilities are well-maintained, safe, clean, and efficiently managed to support employee housing needs. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this position is to supervise all aspects of company compound operations. This includes maintaining high standards for accommodation facilities, ensuring a safe and clean living environment, and effectively managing resources to meet the housing requirements of employees. Key Responsibilities Oversee the daily operations of employee compounds, encompassing accommodation, maintenance, housekeeping, security, and general services. Manage occupancy levels, room allocations, employee movements, and overall housing capacity across assigned compounds. Coordinate with external contractors, landlords, service providers, and internal departments to ensure efficient service delivery. Conduct regular site inspections to ensure compliance with company policies, safety standards, and regulatory requirements. Address employee concerns, operational issues, incidents, and emergencies, while continuously monitoring service quality and contractor performance. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in compound management, facility supervision, or a similar operational role. Demonstrated ability to manage diverse operational aspects including accommodation, maintenance, and security. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in the Eastern region of Saudi Arabia. 911a55de4d092bf8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركه منبع التصافي عن مشرف صيانة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إعداد خطط وبرامج العمل الخاصة بالصيانة، ومتابعة جميع الإجراءات المتعلقة بتحديد أنواع الصيانة المطلوبة، بالإضافة إلى توزيع المهام على فريق العمل وتصميم برامج التدريب اللازمة لهم. يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان كفاءة عمليات الصيانة وفعاليتها. المسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة إجراءات تحديد نوع وطبيعة الصيانة المطلوبة، وتقدير كمية وتكلفة المواد اللازمة لإتمامها. توزيع المهام والواجبات على أعضاء فريق الصيانة بناءً على إمكاناتهم وقدراتهم، ومتابعة وتقييم أدائهم وإنجازاتهم بشكل دوري. تقييم الاحتياجات التدريبية لفرق الصيانة، وتنمية مهاراتهم أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة لتعزيز كفاءتهم. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها لضمان استمرارية العمل وتقليل الأعطال. تصنيف وترتيب وتوثيق وحفظ نتائج وتقارير العمل المتعلقة بجميع أنشطة الصيانة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الصيانة أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على إعداد خطط وبرامج العمل ومتابعة تنفيذها. مهارات جيدة في تقييم الاحتياجات التدريبية وتصميم البرامج المناسبة. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض. عن شركه منبع التصافي تلتزم شركه منبع التصافي بتقديم خدمات عالية الجودة في مجالها، وتسعى لضم الكفاءات التي تساهم في تحقيق أهدافها التشغيلية وتعزيز كفاءة أعمالها في الرياض. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عملنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.
